newsitem.title: USA: Talbots sets structure for Talbots Kids.
newsitem.headline: Talbots sets structure for Talbots Kids.

text.p: Talbots Inc said Monday it has created a separate corporate structure for its Talbots Kids division.
Talbots said the move stems from the continued growth of the division since its inception in 1989. Talbots Kids now has annual sales of about $60 million.

Talbots Kids will be headed by newly appointed senior vice president and general manager Harold Bosworth. The company said Bosworth formerly was senior vice president of Ermenegildo Zegna, a New York-based menswear retailer.
